questions.question: How do raceways differ from ponds?
questions.solution_html:
• How do raceways differ from ponds?
  • Raceways differ from ponds in that raceways are long, narrow tanks with a
  • continuous flow of water, which provides better oxygen supply and waste removal for
  • fish. Ponds are larger, still water bodies where water exchange is limited and fish are
  • cultured in a more natural environment.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: cultured in a more natural environment.

questions.question: How does turbidity influence light penetration and phytoplankton productivity in fish pond?
questions.solution_html:
• How does turbidity influence light penetration and phytoplankton productivity in
  • fish pond?
  • Turbidity reduces the penetration of sunlight into the pond water. When turbidity is
  • high, less light reaches deeper layers, which decreases ph otosynthesis and reduces
  • phytoplankton productivity in the fish pond.

questions.final_answer: phytoplankton productivity in the fish pond.
